query: If I drive 600 km at 80 km/h, how long will it take?
answer: It will take 7.5 hours, which is 7 hours and 30 minutes. Time is distance divided by speed, so 600 km ÷ 80 km/h = 7.5 h. That assumes you hold 80 km/h the whole way. Stops for fuel, food or rest, plus any traffic, will make the trip longer.
